messages.subject: Display X Axis at Top of Horizontal Bar Chart Instead of Bottom?
parts:
Is it possible to display the x axis at the top of a horizontal bar chart instead of at the bottom? Showing the x axis at both the top and bottom would also be ok. This is needed because the chart has many bars and the user currently has to scroll to the bottom of the chart to find out what the x axis represents.

Please let me know if you need a picture or a reproducible example. Thanks!
